name: Miyamoto Tsubasa
source:
She is a member of the volleyball club and is the one who often takes Mako out to club activities. 

Even if she catches a cold, she will recover after eating, sweating, and sleeping! She is a energetic cheerful girl who is always active.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_k.html#character_k]official website[/url]]
